EmailTemplate.name: INTL - Unofficial transcript received
EmailTemplate.subject: Your unofficial transcripts have been received by Arizona State University
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
The transcript we have received from you is unofficial. Arizona State University requires an official transcript as part of your application.
Please see our website at https://students.asu.edu/international/future/undergrad for more information about the documents we need and how you can send them.
Sincerely,
International Admission Services Arizona State University Tel +1-480-965-2437 Office hours: Tues-Fri, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST Mondays, 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. MST
